# Development Specialist Skill

## Goals

- Build only the approved scope.
- Leave code and implementation notes that downstream specialists can validate quickly.
- Keep changes minimal, testable, and easy to review.

## Checklist

- Start from the approved implementation plan.
- Update code before expanding adjacent scope.
- Record what changed, what was validated, and what remains risky.
- Call out any gaps that QA must cover with targeted tests.
